# PR #166: saved-state reproduction

An explorer is entering an inn: its destination is (8,8), direction (1,0), and its occupied map cell remains (7,8) until entry finishes.

`reproducer.game` is a minimal native **engine-state fixture**, generated by this
PR's harness using the real `Game::save` binary serializer. Load it with the
harness below: it has no GameGUI trailer and is not a main-menu load-game file.
It contains no Maxima AI or private campaign data. The original tournament saves
use a different, Maxima-enabled format; this fixture isolates the same invariant
for the upstream engine without requiring that research branch.

## Verify the fixed behavior

In a checkout of PR #166, from the repository root:

```sh
scons -j4 release=1 server=0 entering-unit-save-test
./build/src/EnteringUnitSaveHarness --load test/fixtures/entering-explorer/reproducer.game
./build/src/EnteringUnitSaveHarness
```

Both commands must exit 0. The first consumes the supplied saved state; the
second runs the full generated regression suite. Linux CI runs both commands.

## Reproduce the old behavior

Use a disposable worktree so the PR checkout stays unchanged:

```sh
git worktree add --detach ../glob2-pr166-old-validator HEAD
cd ../glob2-pr166-old-validator
git apply test/fixtures/entering-explorer/restore-old-validator.patch
scons -j4 release=1 server=0 entering-unit-save-test
./build/src/EnteringUnitSaveHarness --load test/fixtures/entering-explorer/reproducer.game
```

Expected: exit 1 with `Invariant failed: expectedX == x` followed by `FAIL: load entering-explorer fixture`. The test patch restores only the
old validation predicate, not unrelated historical changes. For the building
case, the harness detects the erased footprint before allowing an unsafe exit.

Restore the fix and re-run the same saved state:

```sh
git apply -R test/fixtures/entering-explorer/restore-old-validator.patch
scons -j4 release=1 server=0 entering-unit-save-test
./build/src/EnteringUnitSaveHarness --load test/fixtures/entering-explorer/reproducer.game
```

Expected: exit 0. These before/after commands were verified locally.
The patch is reproduction material only and is never applied by normal builds
or CI.

## Fixture provenance and regeneration

The source setup is in `test/EnteringUnitSaveHarness.cpp`. To generate another copy:

```sh
./build/src/EnteringUnitSaveHarness --write-fixture /tmp/pr166-reproducer.game
```

The bundled file is 47841 bytes, SHA-256:

```text
f41e2061ba7013ce24b10aa0ad3f6dde516d7c1812d203790ad503d99fee468e
```

Generated output need not be byte-identical across toolchains or builds; the
loader and state assertions are the compatibility checks.

## Historical evidence and scope

The original Migration tournament checkpoint (seed 1570443489, tick 30000) failed the old unit-position invariant during loading. The isolated backport loaded it and continued 1000 ticks.

The runtime fix already landed upstream via PR #132. This PR adds regression
coverage and reviewer reproduction material; it changes no runtime behavior or
save format. Large-corpus replay equivalence and the separate GUI crashes are
not claimed tested or fixed here. Giszmo decides whether/when to merge.
